$comment: Verified broadcast-rights facts: (raceFamily, year, geo) -> rights-holding broadcaster. raceFamily is the race id minus its trailing -YYYY. Enforced against data/race-data.json by scripts/test-broadcast-rights.js (runs in npm test). Add an entry ONLY when the carrier is verified against a broadcaster-INDEPENDENT source (e.g. coursedujour.com live listings, official race broadcasting page) — never FloSports' own event pages or syndicated how-to-watch reprints, which list races FloBikes cannot stream in the US (Canada-only rights). Context: many races moved US streaming to HBO Max under the 2026 WBD deal while FloBikes kept Canada; see the Renewi Tour 2026 incident (fixed 2026-08-19).
